newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austria cenbank calls for repo bids at unch 3 pct.
newsitem.headline: Austria cenbank calls for repo bids at unch 3 pct.

text.p: The Austrian central bank said on Thursday it was calling for bids on two-week securities repurchase agreements at a fixed rate of three percent, unchanged from last week.
The bank last week announced it would switch to offering two-week repos from its previous seven-day agreements as from January 10 to conform with standard procedure in other European countries.
Last week the central bank allotted 14.04 billion schillings in ten-day repos, filling 15 percent of bids. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 531 12257
